w.r.t. your nonlinear (quadratic) models, we need to make a definitive statement about:

If the linear effect of one side (risk OR benefit) is modified by the quadratic of the other side, can we make a directional statement about how the steepness of the risk OR benefit effect modifies the strength of the opposite of effect of risk & gain on choice?

Is the forest plot robust to switching the YN-diff variable with a Pearson's correlation coefficient quantifying the risk/benefit covariance for each subject?

If we look at only the bottom half of risk/benefit covariance subs, do the convexity/concavity of the images change drastically?
